name: tier0b-bc
notes: Agent Observation Plan O9, Tier 0b: behaviour cloning with the v2 inputs (ml/bc_train_v2.py) on Tier 0's games, one run per history representation (network.history_arch: none | summary | turn_tokens | joint | stream). bc.history_dropout drops event rows in training. options_in_trunk is off: O10's rung A8 found options attending in the trunk cost CHOOSE_ACTION 0.990 -> 0.941 (the model's own default stays on, for older checkpoints). bc.max_tokens caps a training or evaluation piece at that many padded tokens, so memory never spills past the 8 GiB GPU (WSL then falls back to system memory, ~8x slower): joint peaks at 4.6 GiB on a 1.77M-token batch (2026-10-11).
